blocked_output_policy: Do not fabricate numerical attribution or router results. Record not-run requirements explicitly; identity gate rejection is not evidence that no stable router exists.
capacity: Descriptive actual order/stock daily amount and available minute amount only; distinguish same-day turnover from trailing ADV; no impact model or fill changes
freeze_order: Before any state-conditioned outcome analysis; parent annual report was read during identity audit
identity_gate: Any mismatch with frozen parent scaling rule stops economic interpretation, state outcomes and router evaluation. Missing evidence is not PASS.
parent_boundary_semantics: Exact parent continuous stock initial states and SMV6 per-segment callback init reset. Continuous 2018-2026 extension is a different boundary protocol.
return_conventions: Annual return uses prior year-end NAV; 2026 is actual YTD; P&L is account NAV change, never annual return difference times a shared assumed capital
router_qualification: same direction in discovery and confirmation
sufficient independent events and dates with annual blocks reported

state_definitions.active_Demand: Counts/exposure from prior completed holdings; no new threshold
state_definitions.breadth: Parent habitat.py: share >=0.5 MAJORITY_POSITIVE_20D; otherwise MINORITY_POSITIVE_20D
state_definitions.current_account_drawdown: Contemporaneous account drawdown; continuous only without a registered bucket
state_definitions.dispersion: NOT_REGISTERED_IN_PARENT_HABITAT; unavailable unless a frozen source is proved
state_definitions.liquidity: Parent 000852.SH prior completed amount_cny; no new bucket
state_definitions.market_regime: Frozen ATRDR default build_market_state: BULL iff both 20/60 median returns >0 and both positive shares >0.50; BEAR iff both medians <=0 and both shares <=0.50; otherwise TRANSITION
state_definitions.volatility: Parent 000852.SH prior completed daily close percentage-return rolling 20 sample std * sqrt(252); continuous only, no registered high/low threshold

state_timing: Only completed information with state_as_of <= decision_at; daily closes applied after completion; prefix invariance required
